reason: Adds `ToolRegistry.tool_catalogue()` — one line per tool, every tool, marking the six whose full schema is resident — plus the `HOT_TOOLS` declaration it and the builder will share. NOTHING reads it yet: the catalogue is rendered and gated but not wired into any prompt, so no model call changes and Nora behaves identically. It is phase A of design/tool-catalogue/, landed on its own so the line discipline is pinned before anything depends on it. Measured at 1,021 tokens for 55 lines against a 1,400 ceiling. Three first sentences were repaired because the catalogue line IS the first sentence: `where_is` ("was last seen" never said RIGHT NOW, so it read as a question about the past, the same as `where_been`), and `recall_lookups` and `set_music_volume`, whose opening sentences ran to 46 and 45 tokens. tiktoken joins the dev dependencies so the token ceilings measure tokens rather than a character proxy. Nothing a member of a room can observe.
